EmailTemplate.description: Info needed to cancel ASU application
EmailTemplate.name: Decline Request - Multiple applications on file
EmailTemplate.subject: Information needed to cancel ASU application
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Admission Services at Arizona State University. We have more than one application on file for you and need to confirm which application you are requesting we cancel.
Please reply to this email with the following information for the application you wish to cancel:
Term: (example: fall 2017 or spring 2017) Degree type: (example: degree or nondegree) Major: (example: engineering management)
This information will ensure we are canceling the correct application.
If you have any questions, please contact your personal admission representative at https://asu.edu/findmyrep. Thank you for your assistance.
Sincerely,
Admission Services asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
